name: When is the best time of year to get windows weatherproofed in the Bay Area?

mainEntity.name: When is the best time of year to get windows weatherproofed in the Bay Area?

acceptedAnswer.text: The best time to weatherproof windows in the Bay Area is typically during the milder seasons, specifically late spring through early fall. This period generally offers moderate temperatures and lower chances of rain, which are ideal conditions for applying sealants and ensuring proper curing. Avoiding the peak of winter ensures the materials can adhere and cure correctly without being compromised by cold or wet weather, maximizing their effectiveness and lifespan.
acceptedAnswer.description: The best time is late spring through early fall in the Bay Area, when temperatures are mild and rainfall is less likely for proper sealant curing.
